description.value: The FINA Gallery is a public art gallery space located in the foyer of the Creative and Critical Studies Building on the UBC Okanagan campus, programmed by the UBC Okanagan Gallery. It presents research-based and experimental exhibitions with a strong focus on Indigenous, decolonial, and intersectional artistic practices, drawing on a permanent public art collection of over 700 works spread across campus. Visiting cyclists can engage with rotating solo and group shows that foreground Syilx Territory and contemporary Indigenous voices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gallery.ok.ubc.ca is the UBC Okanagan Gallery site, which confirms FINA Gallery is a specific gallery space in the foyer of the Creative and Critical Studies Building at 1148 Research Road, UBC Okanagan campus. The site lists active exhibitions through 2026, confirming the gallery is operational. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, and OSM tags carry no amenity data beyond tourism=gallery.

OSM record contains no address, phone, or email tags; address was sourced from website footer only.
No phone number found in either OSM or website content.
